snp5.1:1.1: V. PĀRĀYANAVAGGA. Vatthugāthā. Kosalānaṃ purā rammā agamā Dakkhiṇāpathaṃ ākiñcaññaṃ patthayāno brāhmaṇo mantapāragū. || ||
snp5.1:2.1: So Assakassa visaye Aḷakassa samāsane vasī Godhāvarīkūle uñchena ca phalena ca. || ||
snp5.1:3.1: Tass' eva upanissāya gāmo ca vipulo ahū, tato jātena āyena mahāyaññam akappayi, || ||
snp5.1:4.1: mabāyaññaṃ yajitvāna puna pāvisi assamaṃ. Tasmiṃ patipaviṭṭhamhi añño āgañchi brāhmaṇo || ||
snp5.1:5.1: ugghaṭṭapādo tasito paṃkadanto rajassiro, so ca naṃ upasaṃkamma satāni pañca yācati. || ||
snp5.1:6.1: Tam enam Bāvarī disvā āsanena nimantayi, sukhañ ca kusalaṃ pucchi, idaṃ vacanam abravi: || ||
snp5.1:7.1: "Yaṃ kho mamaṃ deyyadhammaṃ sabbaṃ vissajjitam mayā, anujānāhi me brahme, n' atthi pañca satāni me". || ||
snp5.1:8.1: "Sace me yācamānassa bhavaṃ nānupadassati, sattame divase tuyhaṃ muddhā phalatu sattadhā". || ||
snp5.1:9.1: Abhisaṃkharitvā kuhako bheravaṃ so akittayi, -- tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā Bāvarī dukkhito ahū, || ||
snp5.1:10.1: ussussati anāhāro sokasallasamappito, atho pi evaṃcittassa jhāne na ramatī mano. || ||
snp5.1:11.1: Utrastaṃ dukkhitaṃ disvā devatā atthakāminī Bāvariṃ upasaṃkamma idaṃ vacanam abravi: || ||
snp5.1:12.1: "Na so muddhaṃ pajānāti, kuhako so dhanatthiko, muddhani muddhapāte vā ñāṇaṃ tassa na vijjati". || ||
snp5.1:13.1: "Bhotī carahi jānāti, tam me akkhāhi pucchitā muddhaṃ muddhādhipātañ ca, taṃ suṇoma vaco tava". || ||
snp5.1:14.1: "Aham p' etaṃ na jānāmi, ñāṇam m' ettha na vijjati, muddhaṃ muddhādhipāto ca Jinānaṃ h' eta dassanaṃ". || ||
snp5.1:15.1: "Atha ko carahi jānāti asmiṃ puthavimaṇḍale muddhaṃ muddhādhipātañ ca, tam me akkhāhi devate". || ||
snp5.1:16.1: "Purā Kapilavatthumhā nikkhanto lokanāyako apacco Okkākarājassa Sakyaputto pabhaṃkaro. || ||
snp5.1:17.1: So hi brāhmaṇa sambuddho sabbadhammāna pāragū sabbābhiññābalappatto sabbadhammesu cakkhumā sabbadhammakkhayaṃ patto vimutto upadhisaṃkhaye, || ||
snp5.1:18.1: Buddho so Bhagavā loke dhammaṃ deseti cakkhumā: taṃ tvaṃ gantvāna pucchassu, so te taṃ vyākarissati". || ||
snp5.1:19.1: ‘Sambuddho' ti vaco sutvā udaggo Bāvarī ahū, sok' assa tanuko āsi, pītiñ ca vipulaṃ labhi. || ||
snp5.1:20.1: So Bāvarī attamano udaggo taṃ devataṃ pucchati vedajāto: "katamamhi gāme nigamamhi vā puna katamamhi vā janapade lakanātho, yattha gantvā namassemu Sambuddhaṃ dipaduttamaṃ". || ||
snp5.1:21.1: "Sāvatthiyaṃ Kosalamandire Jino pahūtapañño varabhūrimedhaso, so Sakyaputto vidhuro anāsavo muddhādhipātassa vidū narāsabho". || ||
snp5.1:22.1: Tato āmantayī sisse brāhmaṇe mantapārage: "etha māṇavā, akkhissaṃ, suṇotha vacanaṃ mama: || ||
snp5.1:23.1: yass' eso dullabho loke pātubhāvo abhiṇhaso, sv-ājja lokamhi uppanno Sambuddho iti vissuto, khippaṃ gantvāna Sāvatthiṃ passavho dipaduttamaṃ". || ||
snp5.1:24.1: "Kathañ carahi jānemu disvā ‘Buddho' ti brāhmaṇa, ajānatan no pabrūhi, yathā jānemu taṃ mayaṃ". || ||
snp5.1:25.1: "Āgatāni hi mantesu mahāpurisalakkhaṇā dvattiṃsā ca vyākhyātā samattā anupubbaso. || ||
snp5.1:26.1: Yass' ete honti gattesu mahāpurisalakkhaṇā, dve va tassa gatiyo, tatiyā hi na vijjati. || ||
snp5.1:27.1: Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, vijeyya paṭhaviṃ imaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena-m-anusāsati. || ||
snp5.1:28.1: Sace ca so pabbajati agārā anagāriyaṃ, vivattacchaddo sambuddho arahā bhavati anuttaro. || ||
snp5.1:29.1: Jātiṃ gottañ ca lakkhaṇaṃ mante sisse punāpare muddhaṃ muddhādhipātañ ca manasā yeva pucchatha. || ||
snp5.1:30.1: Anāvaraṇadassāvī yadi buddho bhavissati, manasā pucchite pañhe vācāya vissajessati". || ||
snp5.1:31.1: Bāvarissa vaco sutvā sissā soḷasa brāhmaṇā Ajito {Tissa-Metteyyo} Puṇṇako atha Mettagū || ||
snp5.1:32.1: Dhotako Upasīvo ca Nando ca atha Hemako Todeyya-Kappā dubhayo Jatukaṇṇī ca paṇḍito || ||
snp5.1:33.1: Bhadrāvudho Udayo ca Posālo cāpi brāhmaṇo Mogharājā ca medhāvī Piṅgiyo ca mahā isi, || ||
snp5.1:34.1: paccekagaṇino sabbe sabbalokassa vissutā jhāyī jhānaratā dhīrā pubbavāsanavāsitā, || ||
snp5.1:35.1: Bāvariṃ abhivādetvā katvā ca naṃ padakkhiṇaṃ jaṭājinadharā sabbe pakkāmuṃ uttarāmukhā: || ||
snp5.1:36.1: Aḷakassa Patiṭṭhānaṃ purimaṃ Māhissatiṃ tadā Ujjeniñ cāpi Gonaddhaṃ Vedisaṃ Vanasavhayaṃ || ||
snp5.1:37.1: Kosambiṃ cāpi Sāketaṃ Sāvatthiñ ca puruttamaṃ Setavyaṃ Kapilavatthuṃ Kusinārañ ca mandiraṃ || ||
snp5.1:38.1: Pāvañ ca Bhoganagaraṃ Vesāliṃ Māgadhaṃ puraṃ Pāsāṇakañ cetiyañ ca ramaṇīyaṃ manoramaṃ. || ||
snp5.1:39.1: Tasito v' udakaṃ sītaṃ mahālābhaṃ va vāṇijo chāyaṃ ghammābhitatto va turitā pabbatam āruhaṃ. || ||
snp5.1:40.1: Bhagavā ca tamhi samaye bhikkhusaṃghapurakkhato bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti, sīho va nadatī vane. || ||
snp5.1:41.1: Ajito addasa Sambuddhaṃ vītaraṃsi va bhāṇumaṃ candaṃ yathā pannarase pāripūriṃ upāgataṃ. || ||
snp5.1:42.1: Ath' assa gatte disvāna paripūrañ ca vyañjanaṃ ekamantaṃ ṭhito haṭṭho manopañhe apucchatha: || ||
snp5.1:43.1: "Ādissa jammanaṃ brūhi, gottaṃ {brūhi} salakkhaṇaṃ, mantesu pāramiṃ brūhi, kati vāceti brāhmaṇo". || ||
snp5.1:44.1: "Vīsaṃvassasataṃ āyu, so ca gottena Bāvari, tīṇ' assa lakkhaṇā gatte, tiṇṇaṃ vedāna pāragū, || ||
snp5.1:45.1: lakkhaṇe itihāse ca sanighaṇḍusakeṭubhe, pañca satāni vāceti, sadhamme pāramiṃ gato". || ||
snp5.1:46.1: "Lakkhaṇānaṃ pavicayaṃ Bāvarissa naruttama taṇhacchida pakāsehi, mā no kaṃkhāyitaṃ ahū". || ||
snp5.1:47.1: "Mukhaṃ jivhāya chādeti, uṇṇ' assa bhamukantare, kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ, evaṃ jānāhi māṇava". || ||
snp5.1:48.1: Pucchaṃ hi kiñci asuṇanto sutvā pañhe viyākate vicinteti jano sabbo vedajāto katañjali: || ||
snp5.1:49.1: ‘Ko nu devo va Brahmā vā Indo vā pi Sujampati manasā pucchi te pañhe, kam etaṃ paṭibhāsati.' || ||
snp5.1:50.1: "Muddhaṃ muddhādhipātañ ca Bāvarī paripucchati, taṃ vyākarohi Bhagavā, kaṃkhaṃ vinaya no ise". || ||
snp5.1:51.1: "Avijjā muddhā ti jānāhi, vijjā muddhādhipātinī saddhāsatisamādhīhi chandaviriyena saṃyutā". || ||
snp5.1:52.1: Tato vedena mahatā santhambhitvāna māṇavo ekaṃsaṃ ajinaṃ katvā pādesu sirasā pati: || ||
snp5.1:53.1: "Bāvarī brāhmaṇo bhoto saha sissehi mārisa udaggacitto sumano pāde vandati cakkhuma". || ||
snp5.1:54.1: "Sukhito Bāvarī hotu saha sissehi brāhmaṇo, tvañ cāpi sukhito hohi, ciraṃ jīvāhi māṇava. || ||
snp5.1:55.1: Bāvarissa ca tuyhaṃ vā sabbesaṃ sabbasaṃsayaṃ katāvakāsā pucchavho, yaṃ kiñci manas' icchatha". || ||
snp5.1:56.1: Sambuddhena katokāso nisīditvāna pañjali Ajito paṭhamaṃ pañhaṃ tattha pucchi Tathāgataṃ. || || VATTHUGĀTHĀ NIṬṬHITĀ.
